name: FinTextQA
description: FinTextQA is a dataset for long-form financial question answering, containing 1,262 high-quality, source-attributed QA pairs from finance textbooks and government websites. It supports evaluation of LFQA systems in finance with diverse question types and contexts, including benchmarking with human ranking, automatic metrics, and GPT-4 scoring.
reputation: A niche but useful finance QA dataset for long-form, source-grounded evaluation, with limited but growing use in finance LFQA research.
notes: Includes a RAG-based LFQA system for benchmarking; focuses on finance domain with noisy context robustness evaluation.
